label: copy phase, fed-back input is 2/u/p/1/n, late in the recall (recall_idx >= 3)
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires only in the copy phase: never on original-phase or delimiter steps, and never on recall_idx 0. Input token identity drives it. The fed-back tokens 2, u, p, 1 and n have 4-5x lift and together carry about 87% of activation mass. q and g are weaker (about 1.4x); most other tokens rarely fire it. Firing rate rises with copy position: it is near zero at recall_idx 1-2 and about 15-28% from recall_idx 3 onward, and highest in long sequences (L=9 holds 41% of the mass). Because the input is the model's own earlier output, in_first is always 0 when it fires. The top activations (about 0.95-1.0 of max) are on 2, p, u and 1 at recall positions 3-8. Dev: precision 0.78, recall 0.70, mass recall 0.84. Misses are mostly low-magnitude firings on other letters. False positives are often the second of two consecutive set tokens, or the same token repeated, so it seems to be suppressed after it has just fired. Adding a not-previous-set-token condition did not help overall.
